label: copy-phase input x mid-sequence (recall_idx>=3, several outputs left)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the fed-back input is x (100% of activations; it is entirely silent in the original and delimiter phases and on every other input token). Within copy-phase x inputs it needs the x to be at least the 4th copy step (recall_idx>=3, i.e. x was original token 2 or later) with several outputs still to go. Mass is concentrated at recall_idx 3-4, t=12-13 and L=8-9. Most copy-phase x inputs meeting these conditions stay silent (precision ~0.24), and no simple variable separates active from silent cases. The upcoming output token weakly raises the rate (out_tok k has 48% precision, o/r/m also raise it), and the top examples often have k and b in the remaining tokens, but neither condition captures much mass. Weak activations near the end of long sequences (to_go 0-2) are missed.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: x, -, j, a, d, c; least: v, e, q, <DEL>) and the token being output (most: k, o, x, r, t, m; least: u, -, b, 0); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, t=12.
